text:
maria: Heads-up — multiple external reports of CVE-2026-21987 (glibc getrandom entropy drain) being exploited in the wild. Affected: our onboarding services and container images using glibc < 2.36. Observed increased blocking on calls to getrandom -> service stalls. Can we triage?

ashwin: @maria thanks. Is there an upstream patch? https://security.example/advisories/CVE-2026-21987 looks like there is a patch and distro backports.

maria: upstream says patched in glibc 2.36.2 and backports available for main distros. Need immediate mitigation while we roll updates.

jonathan: Is this a confidentiality/crypto weakness or DoS? Any KMS impact?

sree: Reports show blocking behavior causing DoS and entropy exhaustion. Not key leakage per se. KMS hosts still require priority because they'll stall on signing operations if they hit blocking calls. Treat as high.

bryan: On k8s, init containers calling getrandom during startup can hang pods. Quick checklist idea: cordon nodes, replace images built against vulnerable glibc, patch nodes, reboot.

ashwin: Quick mitigation plan:
- Identify vulnerable hosts: `dpkg -l | grep libc6` or `rpm -q glibc`
- Cordon nodes for maintenance and drain workloads with restart-critical label
- Roll images rebuilt with patched glibc to registry and re-deploy
- For KMS: snapshot, rotate ephemeral keys, and verify signing operations

maria: +1. @bryan can you run a cluster-wide probe job to detect libc version (e.g. `strings /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6 | head -n1`)? Post results here.

bryan: On it. I'll push a DaemonSet check. Will post results in ~10m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling job "glibc-vuln-scan" started: job-id=gbc-202603-7

ashwin: Prioritization (P0):
- KMS hosts (snapshot + patch + key rotation)
- Prod API gateways and auth proxies
- CI/build runners (they pull secrets and build images)

sree: Also: update private images in registry with patched libc, tag with `patched-glibc-2.36.2`. Enable extra audit logging on canaries: `auditd` rule for getrandom.

bryan: Scan results: 4 clusters with nodes running glibc 2.35 or older. Affected: prod-us-east-1 (3 nodes), infra-ci (2), analytics (1), edge-cache (2).

maria: Start maintenance for prod-us-east-1 now. @oncall-sre please coordinate cordon/drain.

jonathan: If patching can't happen immediately, any temporary shim or workaround? Risky to preload random-seeding shims.

ashwin: Avoid shims unless tested. Safer path: replace affected images, cordon + drain, patch, reboot.

sree: KMS note: HSM-backed root keys appear fine but we should rotate application-level encryption keys. Opening rotation ticket now.

bryan: Commands I'm running for nodes:
- debian: `apt-get update && apt-get install -y libc6=2.36.2-1`
- rhel: `yum update glibc -y`
- verification: `strings /lib64/libc.so.6`

maria: Add audit evidence steps:
- Capture stacks when getrandom blocks: `cat /proc/<pid>/stack`
- Enable auditd rule: `-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -S getrandom`
- Forward to Splunk index `security:glibc`

jonathan: Comms: draft internal incident and legal/comms loop. @bryan can you create the incident?

bryan: Incident created: INC-2026-1034. Blurb: "Internal: glibc getrandom vulnerability (CVE-2026-21987) being actively exploited. Patching in progress for prioritized hosts (KMS, API gateways, build runners). No evidence of key compromise. We'll update as we patch."

maria: Notify vendors and partners about affected images.

sree: KMS rotation ticket KMS-rotate-2026-03 created. Owner: sree. Ashwin to verify. Security to audit.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: patch rollout started to prod-us-east-1 nodes (batch 1 of 3)

ashwin: Post-patch smoke tests to run:
- token signing
- auth flows
- TLS handshake (`openssl s_client -connect <endpoint>:443`)

bryan: Batch1 patch complete — no regressions. Scheduling Batch2 in 15m.

maria: After full patch we should: add CI gating to fail image builds with glibc < 2.36, and add a runtime deny-list for images.

jonathan: Runtime agent option: deny images with `libc.so.6` version < 2.36 and log denials. Good way to stop accidental deploys.

sree: Adding to backlog and tagging as P0.

maria: Checklist:
- [x] Incident created
- [x] Cluster scan run
- [x] Patching started
- [ ] KMS key rotation (in progress)
- [ ] Customer comms draft (ashwin owning)
- [ ] CI gating rule

ashwin: I'll draft customer comms and send to legal/comms for review. ETA ~2h.

bryan: All prod clusters patched by 1915005430.

maria: Closing loop for now — reopen if any anomalies. :thumbsup:
